name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Home Care for Claude Code: the roster and everything that wants a decision, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. An unreported reportable incident outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason as why, label as record, client, place as where_, days, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last

sections.title: The week ahead
sections.note: Every rostered shift for the next seven days.
sections.sql: select ref, to_char(shift_on, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(starts_at, 'HH24:MI') as start, to_char(ends_at, 'HH24:MI') as finish, client, worker, support, state from v_shifts where shift_on between current_date and current_date + 7 and status = 'scheduled' order by shift_on, starts_at

sections.title: The team on deck
sections.note: Clearance state loud. EXPIRED or NONE means they do not roster.
sections.sql: select name, role, screening, to_char(screening_expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as screening_expires, first_aid, shifts_next_7d, round(minutes_next_7d / 60.0, 1) as hours_next_7d from v_workers where status = 'active' order by name

name: money
title: The money
subtitle: Delivered work, payment requests and budget pace, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Delivered, not yet claimed
sections.note: Completed, noted supports (and claimable short-notice cancellations) with no payment request. Build one: claim build.
sections.sql: select ref as shift, to_char(shift_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, client, support, round(minutes / 60.0, 2) as hours, round(value_cents / 100.0, 2) as value_aud, days_waiting from v_unclaimed order by shift_on

sections.title: Payment requests in flight
sections.note: Everything claimed and not yet paid. REJECTED rows are money until resubmitted.
sections.sql: select ref as claim, batch_ref as batch, client, to_char(shift_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as support_date, round(amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount_aud, to_char(claimed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as claimed, state, rejected_reason from v_claims where status <> 'paid' order by claimed_on desc

sections.title: Agreements: budget against pace
sections.note: used% far below time% is money the plan review will take back.
sections.sql: select ref, client, support, round(rate_cents / 100.0, 2) as rate_aud, round(used_cents / 100.0, 2) as used_aud, round(budget_cents / 100.0, 2) as budget_aud, used_pct, elapsed_pct as time_pct, to_char(ends_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as ends, state from v_agreements where status = 'active' order by ref
